name: marketing-static-ad-production
description: Static ad batch for paid social: a dated batch of new image ads iterated from the customer's winning ads or competitors' public ads, in every target language. A repeat-or-explore choice, compliant copy, masters in three mutation modes (copy-led, visual-led, full remix) on Nano Banana Pro by default with copy and the real logo composited, one master review, numbered ad-set folders, tool-made names, localization after a stress sample, a ten-item batch QA and a delivery record. Use when: a new statics batch, iterate our winning statics, competitor-inspired static ads, or continue today's batch. NOT for: one branded graphic or banner (marketing-branded-graphic); localizing finished ads alone (marketing-ad-localization); ranking winners (marketing-winner-analysis); copy alone (marketing-static-copywriting); a multi-channel campaign (marketing-campaign-pack); video ads (marketing-ad-remake); brand capture (marketing-brand-kit); ai-gen use (media-ai-gen); file checks (media-qc).
